summary: Add a narrow multi-field drawing-cover route that recovers the remaining S1 source page and raises the zero-call fixed page-identity gate from 14/15 to 15/15.
decision_refs: S1 was the only remaining selector-v2 miss in the fixed 15-question page-identity gate
Read-only source verification confirmed that page 1 of the PCD drawings file is the requested project identity and scope cover
Only S1 in the fixed fixture requests at least two supported cover fields, so the other 14 stay on the selector-v2 scoring path
approval_evidence: The user directed continued implementation of lightweight, local, verifiable page selection for the advanced-model Reference framework.
known_limitations: The cover route recognizes only an explicit combination of project name, job number, address and scope of work in English.
The route relies on an explicit drawings/plans file name and page 1; it does not infer cover identity from page content.
The 15/15 result is a page-identity gate and does not prove answer quality or change the historical model score.
